briefing: - 清单无在野利用、KEV或勒索软件标记，暂不能确认实际攻击。
- 批量公告集中在Chrome三漏洞、CI四漏洞及F5 dos多版本。
- 优先处置Broadcom 9.8认证绕过，影响版本待补，先隔离暴露面。
- Chrome9.6三漏洞均有PoC，需升级至158.0.8127.36以上。
- F5 dos/边界网关8.1漏洞已有3个PoC，优先排查外部暴露。

items.title: F5 NGINX越界写入可致内存破坏
items.title_zh: F5 NGINX越界写入可致内存破坏
items.summary_zh: 攻击者发送构造请求触发NGINX worker越界写入，导致进程崩溃、内存破坏，ASLR关闭时可执行代码
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.affected: f5 dos >=4.5.0 <=4.7.0; f5 nginx_gateway_fabric >=1.5.0 <=1.6.2
items.action_zh: 升级至F5公告修复版本，无法升级时收敛NGINX网关管理面暴露
items.repro_note: 向NGINX服务发送构造请求触发worker越界写，代码执行需ASLR关闭
items.impact_scope: NGINX网关/反向代理，常暴露公网
items.description: Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR. Impact: An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to crash the NGINX worker process, corrupt its memory, or potentially execute code remotely.

items.title: F5 NGINX释放后重用致DoS
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者发送构造请求触发NGINX对象释放后重用，可致worker崩溃拒绝服务，特定条件下可执行代码
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至4.13.0及以后或厂商修复版本，关注F5安全公告
items.repro_note: 构造请求触发worker对象释放后重用，观察崩溃与内存复用
items.impact_scope: NGINX网关与代理组件，面向公网
items.description: Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR. Impact: This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system or may allow a code execution.

items.title: VMware vCenter目录服务认证绕过
items.title_zh: VMware vCenter目录服务认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可绕过vCenter目录服务认证并取得管理权限，进而控制虚拟化平台
items.affected: Broadcom(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 未授权访问vCenter Directory Service认证接口，构造请求绕过身份校验
items.impact_scope: 虚拟化管理平台，内网核心资产
items.description: VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service. Affected versions: 9.1.x (fixed in 9.1.1.0200); 9.0.x (fixed in 9.0.2.0200); 8.0 (fixed in 8.0 U3m); 5.x (fixed in 5.2.5). Telco Cloud Platform 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2 and Telco Cloud Infrastructure 3.0 are also affected (see KB463116).

items.title: Chrome GPU越界写入沙箱逃逸
items.title_zh: Chrome GPU越界写入沙箱逃逸
items.summary_zh: 攻击者诱导用户访问恶意HTML页面，利用GPU越界写入在沙箱外执行任意代码
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: google chrome <158.0.8127.36
items.action_zh: 升级Chrome至158.0.8127.36或更高版本
items.repro_note: 恶意HTML触发GPU进程越界写，需受害者在未修复Chrome中访问
items.impact_scope: 桌面Chrome浏览器，终端用户
items.description: Out of bounds write in GPU in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)

items.title: Chrome HID释放后重用沙箱逃逸
items.title_zh: Chrome HID释放后重用沙箱逃逸
items.summary_zh: 攻击者通过社工诱导用户安装恶意扩展，借HID释放后重用实现沙箱外代码执行
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: google chrome <158.0.8127.36
items.action_zh: 升级至158.0.8127.36，禁止安装来源不明的Chrome扩展
items.repro_note: 需用户安装恶意扩展并触发HID对象释放后重用，非默认可打
items.impact_scope: Chrome终端用户，需社工诱导
items.description: Use after free in HID in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker leveraging social engineering to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted Chrome extension. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

items.title: Chrome ANGLE越界读取沙箱逃逸
items.title_zh: Chrome ANGLE越界读取沙箱逃逸
items.summary_zh: Android版Chrome中攻击者构造恶意HTML页面，利用ANGLE越界读取在沙箱外执行代码
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: google chrome <158.0.8127.36
items.action_zh: 升级Android Chrome至158.0.8127.36及以上
items.repro_note: Android Chrome加载恶意HTML触发ANGLE越界读取，需用户访问
items.impact_scope: Android Chrome，移动终端用户
items.description: Out of bounds read in ANGLE in Google Chrome on on Android prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

items.title: Chrome远程桌面沙箱外代码执行
items.title_zh: Chrome远程桌面沙箱外代码执行
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者通过构造网络流量攻击Chromoting组件，可能实现沙箱外代码执行，成因细节未公开
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.affected: google chrome <158.0.8127.36
items.action_zh: 升级至158.0.8127.36，限制Chromoting远程桌面使用范围
items.repro_note: 以Chromoting网络流量为入口，成因缺失，需参照Chromium提交记录
items.impact_scope: Chrome远程桌面组件，企业终端
items.description: !MISSING CAUSE! in Chromoting in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via crafted network traffic. (Chromium security severity: Low)

items.title: PHP-FPM请求走私致未授权RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者用单个畸形multipart请求走私到后端，伪造SCRIPT_FILENAME等参数执行任意PHP代码
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 关注PHP-FPM修复版本并升级；临时限制未读请求体的multipart转发
items.repro_note: 发送携带未读请求体的multipart请求，走私伪造SCRIPT_FILENAME/PHP_ADMIN_VALUE
items.impact_scope: PHP-FPM Web中间件，全站后端通用
items.description: PHP-FPM request smuggling through an unread HTTP request body. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use a single crafted multipart/form-data request to forge a backend request with chosen parameters such as SCRIPT_FILENAME, REMOTE_ADDR and PHP_ADMIN_VALUE, which can lead to execution of attacker-controlled PHP code.

items.title: Mosquitto哈希校验缺失可绕过认证
items.title_zh: Mosquitto哈希校验缺失可绕过认证
items.summary_zh: OpenSSL 4.0 FIPS环境下短于8字符口令哈希失败未被检测，可能导致认证校验被绕过
items.action_zh: 关注Mosquitto修复版本并升级；FIPS环境避免8字符以下口令
items.repro_note: 搭OpenSSL 4.0 FIPS环境，用短口令使sha512-pbkdf2失败后登录
items.impact_scope: MQTT消息中间件，物联网接入层
items.description: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.0.0 to 2.0.22 and 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, the return value of password hash functions for sha512-pbkdf2 and legacy sha512 were not checked. Starting with OpenSSL 4.0, sha512-pbkdf2 hashing will fail when using the FIPS provider for passwords shorter than 8 characters. This has the effect that newly created passwords would match against any other password with fewer than 8 characters.

items.title: URL构建库点段分号绕过路径校验
items.title_zh: URL构建库点段分号绕过路径校验
items.summary_zh: 攻击者传入带分号路径参数的..段绕过buildURL父目录检查，越出基础前缀读取或请求
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级至12.8.4及以上，避免用用户输入拼接URL前缀
items.repro_note: 向buildURL传入含分号参数的..段，验证前缀包含校验被绕过
items.impact_scope: 依赖该库的Web服务，路径越界/SSRF
items.description: In versions before 12.8.4, its buildURL function rejects parent-directory path segments by an exact string match, so a segment that carries a semicolon path parameter, such as a dot-dot segment followed by a semicolon and an optional parameter, is not equal to the plain dot-dot form and passes the traversal check, and the WHATWG URL parser keeps it as an ordinary segment so the base-prefix containment check also passes.

items.title: 认证反向代理查询参数认证绕过
items.title_zh: 认证反向代理查询参数认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者携带无效Bearer令牌并附加查询参数，即可冒充任意策略主体通过认证
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；在代理层剥离客户端自带subject查询参数
items.repro_note: 向受保护接口发送无效Bearer令牌+构造subject查询参数，观察身份
items.impact_scope: 认证代理/网关，统一身份入口
items.description: A reverse proxy that only overwrites the header therefore does not stop clients from supplying their own subject. An unauthenticated remote attacker can send an invalid Bearer token together with the query parameter to authenticate as any chosen policy subject.

items.title: Joomla Extension 代码注入(RCE)
items.description: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Code injection via calculation formulas in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Calculation field formulas were executed using PHP eval() without validating their content, allowing backend users with field edit permissions to execute arbitrary PHP code.

items.title: TeamCity沙箱原生库加载致RCE
items.summary_zh: 具备Kotlin DSL配置权限的用户可加载原生库突破沙箱，在TeamCity服务端执行任意代码
items.repro_note: 需Kotlin DSL提交权限，在沙箱内加载原生库触发代码执行
items.impact_scope: CI/CD服务器，可横向获取凭据
items.description: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 remote code execution was possible via native code loading in the Kotlin DSL sandbox

items.title: TeamCity启动类路径库加载RCE
items.summary_zh: 拥有DSL配置权限的攻击者通过boot classpath库绕过沙箱，实现服务端远程代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级至2026.2.1/2026.1.5及以上，限制DSL编辑权限
items.repro_note: 需DSL配置权限，向boot classpath注入库并触发加载
items.impact_scope: CI/CD服务器，构建链路核心
items.description: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2.1, 2026.1.5 remote code execution was possible via boot classpath libraries in the Kotlin DSL sandbox

items.title: TeamCity设置库脚本定义沙箱RCE
items.summary_zh: 可写入Kotlin DSL设置仓库的攻击者通过脚本定义逃逸沙箱，执行任意服务端代码
items.action_zh: 升级至2026.2.1/2026.1.5，审计设置仓库提交权限
items.repro_note: 在设置仓库提交含恶意脚本定义的Kotlin DSL，验证沙箱逃逸
items.impact_scope: CI/CD服务器，可窃取构建凭据
items.description: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2.1, 2026.1.5 remote code execution was possible via script definitions in the Kotlin DSL settings repository

items.title: TeamCity UI补丁回调沙箱RCE
items.summary_zh: 具备DSL权限的攻击者滥用UI patches回调绕过Kotlin DSL沙箱，执行任意服务端代码
items.action_zh: 升级至2026.2.1/2026.1.5，禁止加载不可信DSL配置
items.repro_note: 提交调用UI patches回调的DSL配置，验证沙箱外代码执行
items.impact_scope: CI/CD服务器，内网高价值目标
items.description: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2.1, 2026.1.5 remote code execution was possible via a UI patches callback in the Kotlin DSL sandbox

items.title: TeamCity上下文参数回调沙箱RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者借助Kotlin DSL上下文参数回调绕过沙箱限制，在TeamCity服务端执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 升级至2026.2.1/2026.1.5，限制上下文参数扩展使用
items.repro_note: 需DSL配置权限，构造上下文参数回调触发沙箱逃逸
items.impact_scope: CI/CD服务器，构建配置面暴露
items.description: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2.1, 2026.1.5 remote code execution was possible via a context parameters callback in the Kotlin DSL sandbox

items.title: TeamCity URL流处理器沙箱RCE
items.summary_zh: 具备DSL配置权限者注册恶意URL流处理器突破沙箱，在服务端执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 升级至2026.2.2/2026.1.6及以上，审查DSL引入的处理器
items.repro_note: 在DSL中注册自定义URL流处理器，触发沙箱外代码执行
items.impact_scope: CI/CD服务器，流水线权限面
items.description: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2.2, 2026.1.6 remote code execution was possible via a URL stream handler in the Kotlin DSL sandbox

items.title: TeamCity时区回调沙箱RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者通过Kotlin DSL时区回调绕过沙箱隔离，实现TeamCity服务端远程代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级至2026.2.2/2026.1.6及以上，最小化DSL配置权限
items.repro_note: 需DSL权限，提交注册时区回调的配置触发沙箱逃逸
items.impact_scope: CI/CD服务器，内网横向跳板
items.description: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2.2, 2026.1.6 remote code execution was possible via a time zone callback in the Kotlin DSL sandbox

items.title: Audio 未授权 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct a blind command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1864.

items.title: Generation 代码注入(RCE)
items.description: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability in Jacob N. Breetvelt WP Photo Album Plus wp-photo-album-plus allows Remote Code Inclusion.This issue affects WP Photo Album Plus: from n/a through 9.3.06.003.

items.title: SeaTunnel Web禁用账户仍可登录
items.title_zh: SeaTunnel Web禁用账户仍可登录
items.summary_zh: 持有已禁用账号有效口令者可绕过认证取得新登录令牌，继续访问Web管理功能
items.action_zh: 限制Web控制台暴露，禁用账号时同步吊销令牌与后端凭据
items.repro_note: 用已禁用账号的合法口令调用登录接口，观察是否返回新token
items.impact_scope: 数据集成Web控制台，内网运维面
items.description: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Improper Authentication in Apache SeaTunnel Web 1.0.2 allows a user whose account has been disabled to authenticate with valid credentials and obtain a new login token. This issue requires valid credentials for the disabled account; it is not a credential-free authentication bypass.

items.title: nltk 未授权 命令注入
items.description: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Supplying -jar or an @argfile through nltk.internals.java or StanfordSegmenter.java_class can therefore execute attacker-selected Java bytecode without the unsafe-JAR opt-in.

items.title: Incomplete 命令注入(RCE)
items.affected: Red Hat(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: A command injection vulnerability was found in OpenStack Cinder's SSH-based storage-driver support. Incomplete validation of shell metacharacters allows an authenticated user who owns a volume on an affected backend to supply crafted connection information and inject additional commands into the storage array's management interface.

items.title: 未授权 CWE-367
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Partially overwritten session files can lead to remote code execution. An attacker who can influence the session data, for example through session upload progress, and interrupt a write at a suitable point may inject objects, which can lead to code execution when the application contains a suitable gadget chain.

items.title: Use-after-free 未授权 释放后重用(UAF)
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Use-after-free via repopulation of last_fatal_error_backtrace global after shutdown. This can cause memory corruption and worker crashes, and may allow remote code execution.

items.title: Mosquitto PROXY协议认证欺骗
items.summary_zh: 攻击者经不可信代理伪造PROXY v2头，使broker接受伪造SSL信息并绕过认证
items.action_zh: 关注厂商修复版本；无法升级则禁用PROXY protocol v2监听
items.repro_note: 监听需启用PROXY protocol v2，伪造PROXY头注入SSL信息
items.impact_scope: MQTT消息中间件，常暴露内网/边界
items.description: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, a broker with a listener that is configured to use the PROXY protocol v2 is vulnerable to an untrusted proxy providing details that cause the broker to accept fake SSL information. This can be mitigated by following the documented requirements for PROXY listeners: It is very important that only trusted proxies are allowed to connect to any listener using the PROXY protocol, and that clients are not allowed to connect to the listener at all.

items.title: Apache Iggy 未授权 CWE-613
items.description: Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server HTTP transport. A self-issued JSON Web Token (JWT) identified the user only by numeric user ID, and a new user takes the lowest free ID.

items.title: Apache Iggy Go SDK 未授权 CWE-613
items.description: Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy Go SDK. The TCP client method CreatePersonalAccessToken wrote the 32-bit expiry into the upper half of the 64-bit expiry field that the server reads.

items.title: Linux 未授权 Critical
items.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ceph: fix integer overflow in the snap trace bounds check ceph_update_snap_trace() bounds the two encoded snapid arrays that follow a struct ceph_mds_snap_realm with sizeof(u64) * (num_snaps + num_prior_parent_snaps). An unsolicited CEPH_MSG_CLIENT_SNAP reaches this from a malicious or compromised MDS with no client-side action, as do the snaptraces carried in an MDS reply and in a cap import.

items.title: Linux 未授权 Critical
items.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ceph: reject mdsmaps that claim more than CEPH_MAX_MDS ranks check_new_map() sizes its export-target bitmap from CEPH_MAX_MDS but walks it with newmap->possible_max_rank, which comes straight off the wire: ceph_mdsmap_decode() sets it to max(m_num_active_mds, m_max_mds), then overwrites it with the size of the "in" set. The map arrives on the monitor connection, which is unauthenticated in legacy msgr mode.

items.title: Linux 未授权 Critical
items.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: nfsd: hold cl_lock in client_has_openowners() client_has_openowners() walks clp->cl_openowners and reads so_stateids without clp->cl_lock. nfs4_put_stateowner() unhashes that openowner under cl_lock and then frees it, so a concurrent EXCHANGE_ID with mismatched creds can use-after-free the nfs4_openowner.

items.title: Calling EVP_EncodeBlock 未授权 堆溢出
items.description: Calling EVP_EncodeBlock() with an input length close to INT_MAX may overflow the calculation of the encoded output size and write past the end of the caller-supplied output buffer.

items.title: Visforms重载任务SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者调用公开reload任务，经未加引号占位符注入SQL读取数据
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级Visforms至高于5.6.4/6.2.1的修复版本
items.impact_scope: Joomla站点第三方表单插件
items.description: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated SQL injection in reload task in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Input placeholders in SQL field statements were inserted without quoting in the public reload task, allowing unauthenticated SQL injection in read queries.

items.title: Visforms前端过滤SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者通过前端数据视图排序、半径、发布过滤参数注入SQL，部分无需认证
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级Visforms至高于5.6.4/6.2.1的修复版本
items.impact_scope: Joomla站点第三方表单插件
items.description: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated SQL injection in frontend data view filters in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Sorting, location radius and published filters of the frontend data view were not properly sanitized, allowing SQL injection, partly without authentication.

items.title: RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID 未授权 资源分配无限制
items.description: The QUIC stack queues a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame also for retransmitted NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames. This allows a remote malicious QUIC stack to queue an unlimited number of RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames.

items.title: TeamCity Mercurial RCE
items.summary_zh: 具Mercurial仓库配置权限的攻击者通过恶意仓库内容触发服务端RCE
items.repro_note: 需可配置Mercurial VCS仓库；提交恶意仓库内容触发
items.impact_scope: CI服务器，常持凭据与构建权限

items.title: Multi-User Gateway 未授权 默认凭据

None of these passwords are required to be changed during initial configuration, and they remain at their default values unless the administrator changes them manually. An attacker with network access to the device can authenticate using these default credentials and gain administrative control.

items.title: CRAM 未授权 栈溢出

items.title: BCF 未授权 堆溢出

items.title: jupyter-mcp-server 未授权 CWE-350
items.affected: pip:jupyter-mcp-server <= 1.0.2(修复: 1.0.3)
items.description: A malicious website can use DNS rebinding so that its hostname resolves to a loopback, LAN, VPN, or published-container MCP listener, then send a browser-shaped request that /api/connect accepts to replace runtime_url and document_url values and start a kernel client against attacker-controlled infrastructure. The attacker can thereby cause Jupyter API and WebSocket traffic to reach that infrastructure and can use /api/stop to stop the current notebook kernel.

items.title: WatchGuard Dimension 信息泄露
items.description: WatchGuard Dimension returns unredacted session identifiers for logged-in users in a management API response. A low-privileged Dimension Administrator can retrieve the active session IDs of other administrators, including Super Administrators, while they are logged in, enabling account takeover.

items.title: Dimension Administrator 信息泄露
items.description: WatchGuard Dimension records unredacted session identifiers for logged-in users in its web UI diagnostic log. A low-privileged Dimension Administrator can retrieve this log and extract a Super Administrator's session token while that administrator is logged in, enabling account takeover. This vulnerability is a secondary unmitigated attack path for CVE-2026-78174.

items.title: Dell PowerStore SDNAS 未授权 CWE-338
items.description: Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains a cryptographically weak PRNG vulnerability that could allow a network attacker to decrypt or tamper with NAS SSH/SFTP sessions.

items.title: Fabio 未授权 CWE-41
items.description: Fabio is an HTTP(S) and TCP router for deploying applications managed by consul. Prior to 1.7.3, route/table.go selects targets using raw req.URL.Path, while proxy/http_proxy.go applies per-route ACL and basic-auth checks to the selected target and forwards the raw path to the origin.

items.title: Audio 未授权 CWE-91
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)

A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1862.

items.title: RPM 命令注入(RCE)
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.description: Prior to 5.13.3, an attacker who controls an upstream RPM repository mirrored by a RepoManager instance can provide a package filename through the primary.xml <location href> field; the mirror passes that filename into a shell-interpreted RPM query, allowing shell metacharacters to execute commands as the www-data service account. The target must mirror an upstream repository controlled by the attacker, and the default "Check GPG signatures" option triggers the vulnerable call.

items.title: ASCII 未授权 大小写处理不一致
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: In versions up to and including 9.3.6, middie does not honor the router's caseSensitive setting and matches path-scoped middleware mount paths with a case-insensitive regular expression that does not fold non-ASCII characters, while Fastify's router, when caseSensitive is set to false, lowercases the request path with a Unicode-aware conversion that maps the KELVIN SIGN character (U+212A) to the ASCII letter k.

items.title: MHz 认证绕过(中间人)
items.description: The Guardian 2 alarm unit lacks a mechanism to authenticate control commands sent over 433.92 MHz, which allows an attacker to replay the static commands to impersonate activity. The attacker can also disarm or arm the system at will if a Nexsmart keypad (product link) is in use, thus compromising the functionality of the alarm system completely.

items.title: Red Hat SQL注入
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.affected: Red Hat(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: A flaw was found in Moodle's external database enrolment plugin. Insufficient sanitization of data passed to queries against the external database allows an authenticated user with course editing permissions to perform a Structured Query Language (SQL) injection attack. When this non-default plugin is enabled, an attacker can exploit this issue to view, modify, or delete sensitive records within the connected external database.

items.affected: Splunk(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could use the Automation Dependency Wheel Representational State Transfer (REST) API to write arbitrary files outside the intended directory, which could lead to arbitrary code execution. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not restrict uploaded automation dependency wheel filenames to the intended storage directory.

The bypass of the CVE-2026-30940 fix can permit file writes, overwrites or deletion within the PHP process permissions and, where executable PHP can be written, remote code execution.

items.title: Red Hat 文件链接绕过
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: Red Hat(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: This vulnerability allows for information disclosure when performing offline scans of untrusted filesystem images, such as container images or virtual machine (VM) disks. Because the scanner does not properly restrict symbolic link (symlink) resolution to the target image's root directory, an attacker can supply a crafted image containing links pointing to files on the host system.

items.title: nltk 文件链接绕过
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.description: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. A local attacker who can prepare the extraction target can cause a package member write to overwrite an out-of-root file, violating the pathsec containment boundary and affecting integrity and availability.

items.title: Red Hat 缺失授权(越权)
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.affected: Red Hat(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: A flaw was found in gdm. The CreateRemoteDisplay D-Bus method fails to perform proper authorization checks when initiating a remote display session. A local attacker with access to the login screen environment can invoke this method with an arbitrary username to bypass standard automatic login verification checks. This vulnerability allows the attacker to achieve privilege escalation and start an unauthorized session as any user on the system, including root.

items.title: Collector 权限提升
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to local privilege escalation via the SUID-root podman_wrapper binary on the Collector appliance. A local attacker with low-privileged access to the Collector can exploit insufficient argument validation in the SUID binary to execute arbitrary commands as root, resulting in full compromise of the Collector appliance.

items.title: Splunk SOAR 权限提升
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.affected: Splunk(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: If a Splunk SOAR administrator performs a cluster lifecycle operation, Splunk SOAR could execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the load balancer. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not verify the integrity or ownership of the load balancer helper before running it with root privileges.
